reviews.comment: Course content is laughably irrelevant. Grading is entirely subjective and based on the professors opinions. Besides being inconsistent and unclear, content he explicitly told us would not be covered was tested on in quizzes. Class was a really frustrating waste of time.

Dr. Flint, while interesting at first, does not teach many useful things. His quizzes are knit-picky and focus on minute details from the textbook reading and lecture videos that don't matter. For a graduate level course, I would expect more useful knowledge to be presented.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Flint is great. He is incredibly intelligent and has so much life experience. He really makes you want to learn more. He does not use ecampus, so you don't really know what your grades are. I think I will end up with a B+ but honestly idk. You can tell he wants all of his students to succeed, but he is going to make you work for it.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Graded by few things
